svg.title: Night Shift — five stops, one delivery
svg.desc: A black-and-yellow freight wagon enters from the left and travels one and a half wagon lengths from the left edge as the night city scrolls past. Five loading stations place five cubes in the wagon. When Dispatch reaches the center, the camera stops; the wagon approaches the terminal, unloads, then exits the right edge. A 43.6-second decorative loop, not GitHub activity data. Reduced motion shows a still at the third loading stop.

g.text: A LITTLE PROGRESS AT EVERY STOP.
